name: Cheerfull!
source:
Main character yearns for Yurika since early years, so he is delighted to finally be able to study at the same prestigious school now. But his confession is suddenly turned down. He is drowned in grief when a cheerleading club director forcibly takes him to the clubroom and acquaints him with sempai there. Can these cheerful girls substitute his passion for Yurika?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-january-2007-gekkou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公从小便憧憬由里香，因此终于能与她在同一所名校上学时欣喜不已。然而，他的告白突然遭到拒绝。就在他沉浸于悲伤时，啦啦队社团的负责人强行把他带到活动室，让他认识了社团里的前辈。这些活泼开朗的女孩能够取代他对由里香的感情吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-january-2007-gekkou_no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
